text:
Omar: hey team, unboxing my assigned Mac mini (serial C02XXXXXXX) and after the first reboot post-update it dropped to a firmware password prompt. no way to SSH or continue the Kandji enrollment. anyone run into this with a headless unit?
jen-ict: ugh, thats annoying. did you ever see a prompt to set a firmware password when you were going through setup?
Omar: nope, I went through the quick assistant, logged in with company account, then it said installing updates and rebooted. now its stuck at a black screen with a padlock and password field.
kandji-bot: Kandji last check-in: 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z. Device status: Pre-enrollment (failed post-update). Pending commands: push-profile, escrow-key.
jen-ict: headless minis often shipped from procurement with a previous firmware password still set (rare) or during the update path it can flip into the recovery flow. We can do two things: 1) if you have physical access someone can boot into Internet Recovery and enter the firmware password (not possible without the password), or 2) we can request an Apple Configurator recovery via a local IT pickup (needs physical cable to host Mac) OR 3) if you're remote and can't ship back, we can swap device. Which is preferable?
Omar: I'm remote and can't ship easily this week. swap would be slow. Is there any remote admin backdoor?
alex-sec: remote bypass isn't possible by design (firmware pw protects boot). Security policy forbids trying exploits. We need physical access for firmware reset.
sam-people: Omar - do you have a pickup window in the next 48h? We can arrange a courier to collect for a swap/reprovision. If not, IT can issue a laptop swap approval and fast-shipment.
Omar: a courier pickup tomorrow morning would work. will pack and leave at lobby.
jen-ict: ok Ill file a hardware swap and set Kandji to provision a replacement MDM-first image. in the meantime I'll mark the current device as quarantined and remove any partially-provisioned profiles so it doesn't show up as claimed.
kandji-bot: Action queued: quarantine device C02XXXXXXX. Remove partial profiles request submitted.
jen-ict: Omar - when the replacement arrives, please do NOT set FileVault or any personal recovery key before Kandji completes enrollment. choose the "Company recovery key" path when prompted. Ill also push a quick how-to doc in the ticket about headless-mini setup (USB-C hub + local keyboard needed for first boot if you ever need to troubleshoot).
Omar: noted. thanks. also flagging that my home office has limited UPS power so Ill keep the mini plugged in during swap.
alex-sec: one more security note: once replacement is provisioned, we'll verify institutional escrow with `sudo fdesetup status` and confirm MDM check-ins. also re-register your 2FA device for SSH login if you use a hardware key.
sam-people: courier scheduled: pickup slot 03/19 09:00-11:00 local. ticket #ONB-4892. replacement shipment ETA 03/20.
Omar: amazing, thanks everyone. appreciate the quick coordination.
jen-ict: np. filing a short incident note for procurement to log firmware-password hits on refurbished minis so we can reduce this in future.
